description.text: V Starter Deck: Challenge, a random 60-card deck, ready to play out of the box, with damage counters and a rule book: each holds one Pokémon V, and with luck a Pokémon VMAX as well, the first starter decks to offer one (Venusaur, Blastoise, Eevee and Cramorant VMAX). Its Single Strike and Rapid Strike Urshifu V have art and attacks different from the expansions' cards and are found only here. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
